body.text: Teknoppy's ERPNext data migration services move your customers, suppliers, items, balances and history from Tally, QuickBooks, Zoho Books, Busy, Marg, SAP or spreadsheets into ERPNext, checked at every step. We work with companies across Kerala, India and the GCC, and your old system keeps running until the new figures match.

paragraphs.text: ERPNext data migration is the process of extracting records from your current software, cleaning them, importing them into ERPNext and checking that every balance matches. A typical migration for a small business takes 1–2 weeks, and a larger multi-company move takes 3–6 weeks. Nothing is switched off until your accountant confirms the figures.

As a provider of ERPNext data migration services working from Kochi, we treat migration as an accounting task, not just a file upload. Every trial balance, stock value and outstanding invoice is checked against your old system before go-live.

sections.h2: What Data Can We Move to ERPNext?
rows: Customers, suppliers, items, price lists, chart of accounts
Ledger balances, bank balances and stock values
Unpaid invoices, pending orders and advances
Batch numbers, serial numbers and warehouse quantities
Employees, salary structures and leave balances
sections.note: Our ERPNext master data migration includes cleaning duplicates and fixing missing details such as GSTIN, VAT numbers and addresses. ERPNext balance migration then brings in opening figures as at your chosen cut-off date.

paragraphs.text: Tally is the most common starting point for our clients. Tally to ERPNext migration covers ledgers, groups, stock items, godowns, outstanding bills and GST details. We also handle Tally Prime to ERPNext moves and older Tally ERP 9 data.
Our Tally to ERPNext migration services follow a set order:

items.html: 1. Export ledgers, items and outstanding bills from Tally.
2. Map Tally groups to the ERPNext chart of accounts.
3. Clean duplicate ledgers and missing tax details.
4. Import masters first, then balances and open bills.
5. Match the trial balance and stock summary line by line.

outro.text: Many Tally to ERPNext Kerala clients keep Tally read-only for past years, so auditors can still check history. An ERPNext migration from Tally Prime usually takes one to two weeks for a single company.

sections.intro: We also move data from QuickBooks, Zoho Books, Busy, Marg, SAP Business One, Odoo and custom-built software.

items.text: Busy to ERPNext migration and Marg to ERPNext migration are common for traders and pharma distributors.
SAP to ERPNext migration suits companies leaving high licence costs behind.
Custom software to ERPNext migration covers in-house systems, read directly from their database or exports.
Excel and Google Sheets data is cleaned and structured before import.

outro.text: Whatever the source, ERPNext data conversion turns each record into ERPNext's format, so items, taxes and accounts work correctly from day one. Units of measure, item groups and price lists are mapped too, so your first sales order in ERPNext looks familiar to your team.

sections.h2: How Do We Check Your Data Is Right?
sections.intro: Checking is the most important part of any migration. Our ERPNext migration experts run five checks before you go live:
rows: Every ledger balance, old system vs ERPNext
Quantity and value per item and warehouse
GSTIN or VAT numbers and tax accounts
sections.note: If a number does not match, we trace it to the source record and fix it before go-live. Any provider of ERPNext data migration services you consider should give you this sign-off sheet, and ours is part of every project.

items.html: Duplicate customers and items that split sales history across two records
Wrong opening stock values that distort profit for the whole year
Missing tax numbers that cause errors on the first GST or VAT return
Unmatched advances where customer payments show as unpaid invoices
Rushed cut-offs where transactions are entered in both systems

outro.text: Each mistake is cheap to prevent and expensive to fix after go-live. That is why ERPNext data migration services should always include a cleaning step and a trial import, never a single direct upload.

rows: Review source data, volume and quality
Match old fields and accounts to ERPNext
Remove duplicates and fill missing details
Import into a test system and check
sections.note: For a single company with clean data, the full ERPNext data transfer takes about two weeks. Multi-company groups or messy data take three to six weeks. Your old system stays live until sign-off.

sections.h2: When Is the Best Time to Migrate?

paragraphs.text: The start of a financial year is the simplest cut-off, because opening balances are clean and reports start fresh. A mid-year move also works well: we import balances as at the end of a month or quarter, then bring in open documents. Whichever date you choose, ERPNext data migration services should include a clear cut-off plan agreed in writing.

sections.h2: What Affects the Price of a Migration?
rows: Some systems export cleanly, others need custom extraction
More items, customers and history mean more checking
Duplicates and missing tax details take time to fix
Each company needs its own books and checks
Summarised history costs less than full transaction history
sections.note: We send a fixed quote after the free assessment, so you know the full price before work begins.

sections.h2: Choosing ERPNext Data Migration Services You Can Trust

items.html: Accounting-first checks. Every balance is signed off by your team.
No data loss. Your old system stays available until sign-off.
Clear documentation. You get a record of every mapping and correction.

outro.text: As an ERPNext migration company and ERPNext migration partner, we handle extraction, cleaning, import and checking in one team. Our ERPNext migration consultants also advise on how much history to move, which often saves time and cost. After go-live, ERPNext migration support covers any corrections your accountant raises in the first month.

paragraphs.text: Clients across Ernakulam use ERPNext migration in Kochi, with ERPNext data migration Kochi workshops at our Vyttila office. We provide ERPNext data migration Kerala-wide for traders, manufacturers and service firms.
Our ERPNext data migration India-wide service runs remotely, with GST details carried across correctly.

paragraphs.html: For Gulf businesses, our ERPNext migration services bring across VAT numbers, multi-currency balances and Arabic names. Our ERPNext data migration services run in GST and AST hours for GCC clients. See ERPNext implementation in the GCC.

items.a: No. Your old system stays untouched and available until your team signs off the new figures. Every import is tested first on a copy of ERPNext, so mistakes are caught before the final move.

items.q: How much history should we move?
items.a: Most clients move masters, opening balances and open documents, then keep the old system read-only for history. Full history can be moved too, but it adds time and cost. We help you decide based on your audit and reporting needs.

items.q: Can we keep using Tally during the migration?
items.a: Yes. Your team keeps working in Tally until the cut-off date. We then import the final balances and open bills, and you switch to ERPNext once the figures match.

items.q: How long does it take to migrate to ERPNext?
items.a: A single company with clean data usually takes about two weeks. Larger groups, multiple companies or poor-quality data take three to six weeks.

items.q: Who needs to be involved from our side?
items.a: Usually your accountant, one person from stores and one decision-maker. They confirm the cut-off date, answer questions during cleaning and sign off the final balances. Good ERPNext data migration services need only a few hours a week from them.

items.q: Do you migrate the database directly?
items.a: For some systems, yes. ERPNext database migration reads directly from the old database when exports are limited. For most accounting software, we use exports and ERPNext's import tools, which are easier to check.

items.q: What happens to GST or VAT details?
items.a: We carry across GSTIN, VAT numbers, tax categories and HSN codes for every customer, supplier and item. Missing or wrong tax details are flagged for your team to confirm during cleaning.

paragraphs.text: Send us a sample export from your current system, and we will review its quality, suggest a cut-off date and give you a timeline and fixed quote. There is no obligation.

paragraphs.html: Teknoppy provides the ERPNext data migration services Kerala and GCC businesses rely on when they cannot afford to lose a single balance. Moving is also the right time to set up ERPNext properly, so see our ERPNext implementation service.
